featured_reviews.review_text:
My journey with this store started 2.5 yrs ago on Akshay Tritiya and I am glad to say that I have found the best store and the best team for jewelry shopping. Mrs. Neetu Singh, who is the store manager is a gem of a person. She has answers to all my questions and has a lot of patience to deal with the clientele while there is a lot of pressure from every corner. Moreover, she has become like a family member for us. Be it replacing old designs with new designs or trying to find the right time to buy or sell jewelry, she always provides with the best suggestions. My very first experience was delightful when she helped me find the exact ring design I had in my mind. The design of the ring was applauded by my colleagues in the U.S. who were also persuaded to buy gold from this store.

Coming to her team members, Ms. Tanuja is a cheerful person who always greets us with smile and ensures to give ample time to us showing different designs in different categories. She also keeps us informed about new deals in the store through messages and checks in via calls. It is because of Tanuja’s efforts and hospitable nature that we get convinced to buy something on Diwali from last 2 yrs and I am sure the same will happen this year too. I met both Tanuja and Neetu through my maasi. They love my maasi and it was heart-touching to see that they remembered my Maasi’s birthday recently and surprised her with a delicious cake when we visited the store 2 weeks ago. The other good thing is that the team is understanding of our budget and doesn’t forces us to go overboard.

Recently, we went to get some melting done and Mr. Jayant completed the whole melting project patiently. The process was transparent and it was made sure that we were aware of all the necessary details. Mr. Sudhanshu was also helpful in the whole process and clarified our doubts about weight and next steps.

Lastly, I would like to applaud Mr. Shivam Pandey who took his time to bring out the best bracelet designs for me and other jewelry designs for my maasi. He is a joyful and fun person to talk to and is skillful with keeping the client’s attention intact to his sales pitch and getting the deal closed. My maasi had a major spine surgery 3 months ago and the team is always careful and considerate that my aunt should be comfortable with her movements. They make sure she doesn’t move much yet she can enjoy the thrill of jewelry shopping by bringing all the designs in any category at one table. Mrs. Neetu always sends us home with wonderful gifts as a token of love and our bond keeps growing infinitely.

Dear Parmar Jewellers,

Additionally, you mentioned my visit at closing time and how I kept your staff waiting. According to Google Maps, your closing time is 10:30 PM, and I paid at 21:20 PM, which is well before your stated closing hours. Now, regarding your claim that your staff was waiting for me: I was kept waiting for 50 minutes because your employee couldn’t cross-check the money I gave properly, even though it was counted on a machine by your son. I left your shop around 22:10, which is well within your stated business hours, so the suggestion that your staff was "waiting for me" doesn’t hold up. I would appreciate if you could get your facts straight before making such statements.

In conclusion, I am not disputing that I trusted your store for my purchase, but the arrogance and attempt to shift blame is completely unnecessary. I was expecting a professional experience, not excuses.

Sincerely,
Kartik Chauhan

featured_reviews.name: Mamatha B K Reddy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi everyone,

Today I want to share my personal experience with a company called True Diamond.

On April 7th, I placed an order with them, trusting that they were genuine and followed fair practices. I specifically told them that I need the diamond earring by April 18th for a very important family occasion — a promise I made to my son.

They assured me it would be delivered on time. Based on that trust, I paid ₹10,000 advance immediately through UPI.

But here’s what actually happened…

After several days of no proper update, I contacted them again on April 16th. They then sent me a final quotation — and to my surprise, the gold weight was reduced from 1.3 grams to just 0.98 grams.

That’s nearly a 25% reduction in gold.

But the price? Still the same — ₹28,000.

When I questioned this, they simply said: “It’s a special price. It won’t change.”

So let me ask —
If the gold quantity reduces, shouldn’t the price also reduce?

But they refused to adjust anything.

At that point, I decided to cancel the order — not because of my mistake, but because of their unfair and unethical practices.

Now comes the worst part.

For the ₹10,000 that I paid instantly through UPI, they are now:
– Asking for my bank details
– Saying they have UPI limitations
– And asking me to wait another 7 days for the refund

So in total, they will hold my money for more than 15–17 days.

Is this fair?

Big platforms like Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra — they process refunds quickly, even via UPI. Then why not here?

Also, they kept changing quotations multiple times — adjusting gold weight, pricing, and invoices as per their convenience.

As a customer, this is extremely frustrating.

We come from middle-class families. Every rupee matters. We plan everything carefully. Holding ₹10,000 for 15 days without reason is not acceptable.

I requested to speak to a manager or founder — but no proper response.

So today, I am sharing this experience.

If this creates a negative image for the company, I am not responsible — I am simply asking for my rightful money.

Please be careful before trusting such platforms.

And to True Diamond — I expect a proper explanation and an immediate refund.
